The '''Dark Thicket''' is the third section of [[The Park]].

{{ZoneText|Chop down Dark Oak logs.|Talk to &cRyan&f about the &6Trial of Fire&f.}}

== Features ==
The '''Dark Thicket''' features a few attractions.

=== Trials of Fire ===
{{Main|Trials of Fire}}
The player can enter the campfire located next to {{NPCSprite|Ryan}} to begin the [[Trial of Fire]]. They must survive {{Green|10s}} in the fire whilst it constantly deals [[True Damage]]. There are 30 Trials, each dealing more and more damage per second. After successfully completing a Trial, the player can talk to {{NPCSprite|Ryan}} to upgrade their [[Campfire Badge]].

After completing the [[Trial of Fire]] for the first time, {{NPCSprite|Ryan}} will ask the player for {{Item|Dark Oak Log|amount=256}}s. Giving these will complete "The Campfire Cult" [[Quests|Quest]], rewarding the player with the {{Item|Campfire Initiate Badge}}, {{Coins|2,000}}, {{Skill XP|+1,000 Foraging}}, and access to the {{Zone|Savanna Woodland}}.

=== Howling Cave ===
{{Main|Howling Cave}}
Near the middle of the '''Dark Thicket''' lies a breakable wall that can be blown up with an {{Item|Explosive Bow}} or {{Item|Superboom TNT}}. Here, you will find the {{Zone|Howling Cave}}, where {{Item|Pack Spirit}}s, {{Item|Howling Spirit}}s, and {{Item|Soul of the Alpha}}s will spawn. This is one of three caves designed for [[Wolf Slayer]]. {{NPCSprite|Old Shaman Nyko}} resides here.
